dispositions.topic_text: Whether tests must assert exact monetary policy constant values rather than accept imported values
dispositions.what: INV-037: the checks compare MONEY_CURRENCY, MONEY_FRACTION_DIGITS and MONEY_ROUNDING with the decided literals EUR, 2 and ROUND_HALF_UP, not only with the imported values

dispositions.topic_text: Currency-mismatch enforcement and typed rejection contract across monetary operation boundaries
dispositions.what: INV-037: a foreign-currency refusal (currency_mismatch, nothing written) at every amount-bearing operation with a currency input, not only at validate_eur_amount and import_snapshot

dispositions.topic_text: Whether INV-041 must prove overall progress uses unrounded intermediate products
dispositions.what: INV-041: an overall-progress case where the unrounded products give another result than the rounded completed-work values
